# Expert Working Group 3.3: Agenda & Meeting Resources

**Thursday, September 10, 2026 | 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (PST)**

Welcome to EWG 3.3. During this meeting, we will review current results for the Gulf of California Ocean Health Index goals **Biodiversity**, **Clean Waters**, and **Natural Products**. Our objectives are to clearly explain each goal model, flag regional scores that do not make sense, and gather your feedback on key methodological decisions.
